name: Okan Diner
notes: Restaurant's own domain is hijacked (multi-hop redirect to an unrelated site) so DoorDash is the best reachable source. DoorDash's rendered DOM/JSON-LD shows the store gated (0 items), but the escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push chunks) carries the full GraphQL response -- 66 MenuPageItem objects across 10 MenuBookCategory sections (Appetizers, Kama-Meshi, Ramen, Original Udon, Seiro, Nabeyaki, Hot Noodles, Cold Noodles, Hand Roll Sushi, Cut Roll Sushi). Cross-checked against SinglePlatform (restaurant-submitted, tier 4): 8 of 10 overlapping items match to the cent (Beef Shabu Shabu Salad $10.50, Deluxe Curry Udon $13.50, Nabeyaki Udon $12.00, Sukiyaki Udon $13.00, Zaru Cold Noodles $8.00, Neba-Neba Cold Noodles $11.00, and both ramens' 'small' price); Blue Crab Salad ($10.50 SP vs $12.50 DD) and Carbonara Udon ($12.50 SP vs $13.00 DD) differ slightly, consistent with SinglePlatform being the older/stale side rather than markup. Markup test against 1.04/1.1/1.15/1.2/1.25/1.3 divisors: no divisor clears 30% clean (max 27.3% at 1.2), inside organic noise, so DoorDash is not carrying a uniform delivery markup. Ramen items priced here are the 'Small' size where SinglePlatform showed a Small/Large split; noted as base price. Categories reached: all 10 present in the DoorDash payload. No lunch/bento section found on SinglePlatform (checked directly, contrary to an earlier web-search summary that mentioned one) or anywhere else, so none is included.

name: Kaiyo Sushi
notes: order.online (DoorDash white-label) DOM shows only a 'Most Ordered' carousel; full menu read from the escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (self.__next_f.push chunks) -- 21 MenuPageItemList categories, 166 MenuPageItem objects, matching the numItems counts in the payload's menuCategories list exactly (complete, not a sample). Dropped the 'Single use utensils' category (5 items: chopsticks/fork/napkin/soy sauce/spoon) -- all $0.00/unpriced, a free-add-on adjunct, not food. 161 priced dishes kept across 20 categories: Blue-Fin Tuna Weekly Special, Wings, Rice Bowl/Rice Plate, Bento & Rice Bowl, Korean Noodle Soup, Appetizer, Classic Roll, Special Roll, Kaiyo Favorite Roll, Classic Maki Roll, Add On/Side, Chef's Special, Salad, Hot Baked Special, Nigiri, Sashimi, Sushi Bento, Hand Roll, Dessert, Beverage. Markup test against 1.04-1.3 divisors: no divisor clears 30% clean (max 28.0% at 1.25), inside organic noise -- passes. Checked allmenus.com's Grubhub-branded listing for cross-check: it names identical dishes with matching descriptions (Crazy Bomb, Monkey Balls, Snow Ball, Edamame, Fried Calamari) but at non-uniform, 30-65% lower prices (Crazy Bomb $7.14 vs $10.50 here, Snow Ball $9.00 vs $12.00, Edamame $4.20 vs $7.00) -- not a clean common-divisor markup (ratios 1.31-1.67, all different), so per playbook this is staleness on the allmenus side, not evidence against order.online. allmenus' OWN price set divides cleanly by 1.2 on 95.8% of its 142 items, meaning it carries its own internal markup structure over a now-outdated base -- discarded entirely, not used for corroboration. No other independent priced source (SinglePlatform, restaurant's own site) was found, so this stands as a single tier-3 source.

name: Harvest Taco Shop
crossCheckedAgainst: https://www.foodboss.com/san-diego-ca/harvest-taco-shop-9350-clairemont-mesa-blvd-san-diego-delivery (aggregates Postmates/Uber Eats -- different owner than Grubhub/allmenus)
notes: Work list's own listed website (harvesttacoshopgo.site) does not resolve (DNS failure, both http and https, -k tried) -- dead/never-registered domain. A same-named 'harvesttacoshopgo.twupro.com' site was checked and is a generic templated placeholder (marketing filler like 'Street Tacos - Authentic style - Best Seller' with emoji headers, no real prices) -- not used. Primary source is allmenus.com (Grubhub-owned, tier 5, ~120 items across 16 sections, address 9350 Clairemont Mesa Blvd matches exactly). Cross-checked against FoodBoss, which aggregates Postmates and Uber Eats (Uber-owned -- independent of Grubhub) -- dozens of items match to the cent (Beef Soup $5.55, Flautas $5.95, Bunuelos $1.25, all burrito/torta/tostada prices, etc). Markup test on allmenus prices: no divisor clears 18% clean (max 17.5% at 1.1), inside organic noise -- passes. One item dropped for disagreement: 'Chips w/ Guacamole' is $8.50 on allmenus vs $3.95 on FoodBoss (2.15x, not a clean-divisor markup, just conflicting/stale data) -- excluded rather than guessed. Where allmenus collapsed an item into an 'X or Y' choice line, FoodBoss's fuller per-item breakdown was used to split it into separate priced rows (Taco Salad Beef/Chicken Taco, Two Beef/Chicken Tacos, Two Beef/Chicken Sopes, Two Cheese/Beef/Chicken Enchiladas) since both variants share the same source price. Also caught: allmenus' concatenated text reads as if 'Carne Asada $2.25' and 'Al Pastor $2.25' are separate 'Taco Salad' items, but FoodBoss's Taco Salad section has no such rows -- those are the Carne Asada Taco and Al Pastor Taco already recorded under Tacos, so they were not duplicated. Categories reached: Soup, The Big Plate, Burritos, Enchiladas, Tortas, Tostadas, Seafood, Chimichanga, Tacos, Taco Salad, Daily Specials, Combination Plates, Quesadillas, Side Orders, Extras, Drinks -- both sources cover the same full section list.

name: Pizza Parlor
notes: Navy MWR facility page (coronado.navylifesw.com, address S. O St. & McCain Blvd, Bldg. 614, Coronado -- matches work list exactly) links a 'Pizza Parlor Menu.pdf' whose real download URL had to be pulled out of the page's raw HTML (the visible link text carried no href in the rendered/stripped text). pdftotext -layout on the 18MB PDF (mostly embedded images) yielded a clean, small (11.5KB, 2 content pages) text layer that paired every name to a price without scrambling -- a good outcome unlike the wine-list-scrambling cases in FINDINGS. Its own site's ChowNow storefront (direct.chownow.com/order/969/locations/1708) was also found but is a pure client-side React app behind a Cloudflare challenge with no discoverable API endpoint (guessed several api.chownow.com paths, all 404) -- consistent with the playbook's list of ChowNow as needing a browser; the PDF made that unnecessary here. Sized items (pizza/calzone Medium/Large, meal-deal A-la-carte/Meal-Deal, cookies 2-pc/12-pc, canned/16oz/pitcher beer) are recorded as separate priced rows. Excluded as modifiers, not dishes: per-topping surcharges ($6.95 party-pizza topping, $1.50/$2.50/$3.00 build-your-own topping tiers, $0.60 wing-sauce add, $3.95 panini meal-deal add-on). Included 'Sauce/Dressing Cup $1.00 each' as one representative priced line since the source lists it as a standalone purchasable menu section (Sides and Sauces) rather than a per-item modifier.
